name: Kairen Isamu
source:
A User that Chris brought along. He is currently a member of Gotou Faction's research facility.
Matching his hot-tempered nature, his ability is also about fire creation and manipulation, although it still has a limit, being unable to set a target on fire at will.
Before joining Gotou Faction, he was a fisherman from the bay area.
